data.long_meaning: The name Paddy originates from the Irish name Patricius, which is derived from the Latin word 'patricius' meaning 'noble'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with St. Patrick, the patron saint of Ireland. He is known for bringing Christianity to the Irish people in the 5th century. The name Paddy carries the meaning “Patrick, derived from Patricius, meaning 'noble'” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Paddy usually hope their child will grow to embody patrick, derived from patricius, meaning 'noble' and live with faith, good character and purpose.
